      Before your call

      Warning signs

      • The meeting link arrives minutes before the call
      • The call needs a meeting app you have never heard of
      • You are asked to run a repo or a command
      • There are installers only for Windows and macOS

      Do this instead

      • Ask to move the call to a tool you already use
      • Search the company, the app and the domain first
      • Run test code only in a throwaway virtual machine
      • Take your time
